notes.title: Music Drive: Chase the Beat is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Music Drive: Chase the Beat is now available on Steam![/b] [/p][p]Buckle up for a retro-futuristic car combat game made in the favelas of São Paulo, powered by unreleased tracks from NP Vocal and rising stars of Brazil’s independent music scene.[/p][p]Take control of Tina and Tunner, an iconic duo on a mission to retrieve stolen cassette tapes containing unreleased music — all while drifting, dodging and detonating enemies across chaotic urban arenas.
[/p][p][b]🎮 FULLY PLAYABLE ON STEAM DECK[/b][/p][p]Whether you’re at home or on the go, Music Drive runs smooth and loud on your Steam Deck — just the way we like it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]💿 FEATURING ORIGINAL MUSIC BY NP VOCAL[/b][/p][p]Every race is backed by unreleased tracks from NP Vocal and guests. This is more than a game — it’s a music drop with explosions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🏆 CHALLENGE THE STREETS, CLIMB THE SCOREBOARDS[/b][/p][p]Can you reach the top score in each mission? Prove you're the fastest and the deadliest in your neighborhood.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🌐 JOIN OUR COMMUNITY ON DISCORD[/b][/p][p]Share your high scores, suggest new artists, and get behind-the-scenes content directly from the devs.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/qubyte"]👉 Join now[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]🛞 REPRESENTING THE REAL STREETS[/b][/p][p]Developed by a team of artists, coders, and creatives from the periphery of São Paulo, Music Drive is a statement, a celebration, and a new beat in the gaming world.[/p]
